title: 评估LLM水印在医学文本中的影响
summary: 首次系统研究LLM水印对医学性能的影响，在11个LLM和7个VLM上基准测试5种水印方案。引入专家验证流程审计医学推理质量、术语准确性和幻觉。发现水印会导致词汇损坏、术语幻觉和图像发现误归因等严重退化，强调领域特定评估对安全部署的必要性。
summary_en: First rigorous study of how LLM watermarks affect medical performance, benchmarking 5 schemes across 11 LLMs and 7 VLMs. Introduces expert-validated pipeline to audit reasoning quality, terminology, and hallucinations. Reveals watermark-induced degradation including lexical corruption, hallucinated terms, and misattribution, emphasizing need for domain-specific evaluation.
